notes: For d = n-4, n odd: HS(E/(f)) = LN bound iff B_f(alpha,beta) = [alpha^beta^f] is nondegenerate on E_2. Explicit family f_n = Hodge dual of sum_S (max S - min S) e_S: B_f full rank mod 1000003 for odd 7 <= n <= 23, so these attain the LN series (rank mod p + LN lex lower bound certify over Q). Sparse cyclic 0/+-1 forms attain it for all odd d, 5 <= n <= 13, (n,d) != (9,3). New cases where the LN bound is the minimal series: (12,7),(13,7),(13,9),(15,11),(17,13),(19,15),(21,17),(23,19). Outside Lean: everything (hand reduction; mod-p ranks in Python).
